SourceFile
  RootPackage
  class Gate(var waiter: Continuation<Int>?)
    fun complete
    fun fail
  class Registration(val gate: Gate), SuspendRegistration<Int>
    public fun register
  class ImmediateTask(), SuspendTask<Int>
    public suspend fun run
  class ImmediateFailureTask(), SuspendTask<Int>
    public suspend fun run
  class WaitingTask(val gate: Gate), SuspendTask<Int>
    public suspend fun run
  class ThrowingCompletion(), Continuation<Int>
    public fun resume
    public fun resumeWithException
  fun launch(task: SuspendTask<Int>, completion: Continuation<Int>)
    Call startCoroutine
      Var task
      Var completion
  fun main()
    try
      Call launch
        Call ImmediateTask
        Call ThrowingCompletion
    catch exception: IllegalStateException
      Call println
        StringLiteral "immediate-success"
    try
      Call launch
        Call ImmediateFailureTask
        Call ThrowingCompletion
    catch exception: IllegalStateException
      Call println
        StringLiteral "immediate-failure"
    val success
      Call Gate
        Var None
    Call launch
      Call WaitingTask
        Var success
      Call ThrowingCompletion
    try
      MethodCall complete
        Var success
        IntLiteral 1
    catch exception: IllegalStateException
      Call println
        StringLiteral "resumed-success"
    val failure
      Call Gate
        Var None
    Call launch
      Call WaitingTask
        Var failure
      Call ThrowingCompletion
    try
      MethodCall fail
        Var failure
    catch exception: IllegalStateException
      Call println
        StringLiteral "resumed-failure"
